definition: Scenario label attached to an event
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Identifier only; selected scenario may be illustrative.

definition: The stochastic run number within the scenario
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Not a patient or hospital ID.

definition: Seed for pseudorandom draws used by the run
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Same configuration/seed should reproduce a run.

definition: Ordered event-log row number within one run
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Useful for distinguishing simultaneous event notifications.

definition: Exact model clock time since simulated start
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Use for calculations; never seconds or a real hospital timestamp.

definition: Explicit source time unit
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Always hours since simulation start in v3.

definition: Human-readable representation of elapsed simulation hours
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Day 1 starts at time zero; 168 hours is start of Day 8 after seven complete days.

definition: An optional calendar label obtained by adding elapsed hours to an arbitrary user-selected start
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Does NOT model actual weekday shifts or clock-dependent requests.

definition: Event transaction or notification
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Only DEMAND/REPLENISHMENT_ARRIVAL change quantities transactionally.

definition: Description of how to interpret the event row
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: SHORTFALL is an informational notification and must not be summed as new demand.

definition: Stock just before a transaction when logged
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: May be blank on notification rows.

definition: Usable stock after the event row
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Multiple rows at the same time can have same stock.

definition: AVAILABLE LOW CRITICAL or UNAVAILABLE based on the configured state thresholds
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Label is a model-defined operational classification not a clinically established risk category.

definition: Amount requested during a DEMAND transaction
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: In v3 non-DEMAND events have zero demand quantity.

definition: Amount fulfilled in a DEMAND transaction
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: In v3 non-DEMAND events have zero fulfilled quantity.

definition: Amount of one demand request not fulfilled
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: In v3 non-DEMAND events have zero unmet quantity to avoid double counting.

definition: Running sum of unmet demand from primary DEMAND events
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: It stays unchanged for subsequent notifications and replenishments.

definition: Change in cumulative_unmet relative to the previous event row
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Equals transaction_unmet_quantity on correctly logged v3 event traces.

definition: Shortfall amount displayed in a SHORTFALL notification for reference only
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Do not sum as new unmet demand.

definition: Event index of the DEMAND transaction related to a SHORTFALL notification
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Links notification to its original demand event.

definition: Demand quantity on DEMAND rows and zero elsewhere
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Safe column to SUM for total requested amount even for legacy exports.

definition: Fulfilled quantity on DEMAND rows and zero elsewhere
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Safe column to SUM for total fulfilled amount even for legacy exports.

definition: Unmet quantity on DEMAND rows and zero elsewhere
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Safe column to SUM for total unmet even for legacy exports.

definition: Replenishment quantity on REPLENISHMENT_ARRIVAL rows and zero elsewhere
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Safe column to SUM for total received replenishments.

definition: Whether the row is a primary DEMAND transaction
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Filter TRUE to compute requested fulfilled or unmet demand.

definition: Whether the row is a primary replenishment arrival
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Filter TRUE to compute received stock.

definition: Whether a replenishment order is pending immediately after the logged event
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Can remain TRUE at the horizon if scheduled arrival lies after the run ends.

definition: Trigger level used on a REORDER_INITIATED row
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Not necessarily repeated in every event row; applies only to the configured policy.

definition: Future model-clock hour when the initiated replenishment is expected to arrive
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Only present for relevant order events; may exceed horizon.

definition: Display of scheduled replenishment hour
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Human-readable label not a stochastic calendar time.

definition: Optional calendar label for scheduled replenishment
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: For interpretation only unless a later model explicitly includes calendar effects.

definition: Stock added by a REPLENISHMENT_ARRIVAL event
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Blank on other events.

definition: State immediately before the underlying inventory change if recorded
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: May be blank for auxiliary events.

definition: State immediately after the underlying inventory change if recorded
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: May be blank for auxiliary events.

definition: Text
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: rate or patient_volume

unit_or_type: Configured number of simulated patients over the selected horizon
definition: Integer
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Illustrative workload input; not a hospital census estimate

unit_or_type: Illustrative probability that a simulated patient generates one resource request
definition: Numeric
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Patient-volume mode only; must be justified or replaced through RO1

definition: Selected request-generation mode
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: rate or patient_volume; patient-specific summary fields apply only to patient_volume mode

definition: Number of simulated patient workload entities configured over the horizon
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Exactly this many PATIENT_ARRIVAL events are generated in patient-volume mode; not an estimate of real hospital census

definition: Configured illustrative probability that a simulated patient generates one request
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Used only in patient-volume mode; must be supported or replaced through RO1 before final thesis evaluation

definition: Configured length of the simulation horizon
how_to_interpret_or_aggregate: Parameter metadata on each event row; the model clock remains elapsed hours
